title: BC DAY ITALY II : 7th May 2026
summary: BC DAY ITALY II is a free community event on May 7, 2026 in Milan for Dynamics 365 Business Central users, partners, and customers. The event features technical and functional sessions in Italian language with attendee and sponsor waiting list registration, plus an open call for speaker submissions.
key_points: Free second edition of BC Day Italy on 7 May 2026 at Microsoft House in Milan, approved by the Directions for Partners committee
Sessions are in Italian, technical and functional, with a focus on the Italian localized version
Attendees and sponsors register on waiting lists and get an email when the list is processed
Call for speakers is open for functional, technical and integration sessions in Italian
Everyone attending in person must register, including speakers and sponsors
